In addition, we may suffer financial and reputational damage because of lost or misappropriated confidential information belonging to us, our current or former employees, our bottling partners, other customers or suppliers, or consumers or other data subjects, and we may become exposed to legal action and increased regulatory oversight, including governmental investigations, enforcement actions and regulatory fines.</untrusted_document>
